description: Delete a wiki page: it goes to its space's TRASH, with every page beneath it, and waits there 30 days before it is deleted for good — 'inTrashUntil' says when. Until then the project's administrators can bring it back with restore_wiki_page (list_wiki_trash lists the trash). Identify it by 'id', or by 'spaceKey' + 'title'. A page with children takes its whole subtree with it, so that is refused unless you pass includeChildren: true — the answer names what would go. The space home page can never be deleted. Requires permission to edit the wiki.

includeChildren.description: Delete the page's descendants along with it. Off by default.

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.

name: delete_wiki_page
title: Delete wiki page
